decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the method statement and specification  submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the petrol tanks are used.

Condition : 3 - The works should be undertaken in accordance with the method statement supplied with the application and the recommendations detailed in the Subadra Report ref 01427 CL 001, dated June 2001. A validation report for the works be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval prior to commencement of development
description: Replacement of underground storage tanks and installationof underground LPG storage tank.
